        <h2>How to reach us</h2>
        <p>
          <strong>CHIRAL Bangladesh</strong><br>
          Centre for Health Innovation, Research, Action and Learning<br>
          Dhaka, Bangladesh
        </p>
        <p>
          The centre runs on a virtual HQ model: there is no office to visit and
          no postal address. Everything happens over email, chat, video calls and
          GitHub, which is what lets students at universities anywhere in
          Bangladesh take part on equal terms. Email is the front door — write to
          us and we will set up a call.
        </p>

        <h2>Response times</h2>
        <p>
          Everyone here is a volunteer, so replies take a few days rather than a
          few hours. If something is time-critical, say so in the subject line.
        </p>

        <h2>Meeting in person</h2>
        <p>
          We have no premises, but the people do exist. Seminars, workshops and
          conference sessions are announced on the
          <a href="../events/">events page</a>, and that is where to find us
          face to face.
        </p>
